ds_quickemotes.wheel.info_tooltip_quick:
■ This is the quick emote wheel.
- You need to add emotes yourself before first use.
- Click "Edit Combos" below to create combos and add emotes.
- Hold the key to open, move the cursor to a target sector and release to apply that combo; repeat on the same sector to turn it off.
- Left click a sector to toggle it; right click to §6force-loop§r§f it.
- Use the §6mouse wheel§r§f to flip pages; release over or click the "Cancel all emotes" sector to stop everything.
ds_quickemotes.wheel.info_tooltip_full:
■ This is the full emote wheel: every emote of the current body.
- Hold the key to open, move to a target sector and release to apply; repeat on the same sector to turn it off.
- Left click a sector to toggle it; right click to §6force-loop§r§f it.
- Use the §6mouse wheel§r§f to flip pages; release over or click the "Cancel all emotes" sector to stop everything.
- Preview area: drag with the left/right mouse button to rotate/pan.
- Click "Save Combo" to add the emotes currently in use as a new combo in one click.
